# Elektronische Abstimmung vorbereiten: Checkliste für Versammlungsleitung und Verwaltung

Quelle / Source: https://www.infowhyse.com/abstimmloesungen/

## Kurzantwort

Eine elektronische Abstimmung entscheidet sich nicht am Veranstaltungstag, sondern in der Vorbereitung. Die größten Fehlerquellen sind selten technisch, sondern unklare Abläufe, falsch ausgelegte Satzungen und fehlende Organisation. Klären Sie **Stimmrechte, Vollmachten, Mehrheiten, Registrierung und Dokumentation** vor der Versammlung und führen Sie einen **Testlauf** durch.

## Checkliste

### 1. Regeln klären (Wochen vorher)
- [ ] Wer ist stimmberechtigt? Gibt es unterschiedliche Stimmgewichte?
- [ ] Sind Vollmachten oder Stimmrechtsübertragungen zulässig, in welchem Umfang?
- [ ] Welche Mehrheiten gelten für welchen Tagesordnungspunkt (einfach, absolut, qualifiziert)?
- [ ] Wie ist die Beschlussfähigkeit definiert?
- [ ] Müssen einzelne Personen bei bestimmten Punkten von der Abstimmung ausgeschlossen werden?
- [ ] Welche Abstimmungen erfolgen geheim, welche namentlich?
- [ ] Ist Hybrid oder Online zulässig (Gesetz, Satzung, Geschäftsordnung)?

### 2. Inhalte vorbereiten
- [ ] Tagesordnung und Anträge anlegen oder importieren
- [ ] Fragestellungen eindeutig formulieren (Ja/Nein/Enthaltung, Auswahl)
- [ ] Kandidatenlisten und Wahlmodus (Wahlgänge, Stichwahl) festlegen

### 3. Teilnehmer und Registrierung
- [ ] Teilnehmerverzeichnis mit Stimmrechten und Gewichten
- [ ] Vollmachten vor der Versammlung erfassen und prüfen
- [ ] Geräteausgabe oder Zugangscodes organisieren
- [ ] Kurze Einweisung der Teilnehmer planen

### 4. Technik
- [ ] Raum, Beamer, Empfängerposition und Reichweite prüfen
- [ ] Ersatzgeräte und Ersatzbatterien einplanen
- [ ] Bei Hybrid: Netzwerk und Zugangsdaten testen
- [ ] Testlauf mit Moderation und Protokollführung

### 5. Am Veranstaltungstag
- [ ] Geräte vor Beginn testen
- [ ] Beschlussfähigkeit vor jeder relevanten Abstimmung prüfen, besonders wenn Teilnehmer kommen oder gehen
- [ ] Änderungen bei Vollmachten oder Stimmrechten möglichst nicht mitten in der Versammlung

### 6. Nach der Veranstaltung
- [ ] Bericht speichern (PDF, Excel, Text)
- [ ] Ergebnis in das Protokoll übernehmen
- [ ] Sitzungsdaten gemäß Datenschutz löschen oder archivieren

## Typische Fehler

- Satzung nicht vorab geprüft, Mehrheiten falsch angelegt
- Einheitliche Mehrheit für alle Anträge verwendet
- Vollmachten erst in der Versammlung bearbeitet
- Geräte ohne Zuordnung ausgegeben
- Funkempfänger ungünstig platziert
- Teilnehmer nicht über den Ablauf informiert
- Änderungen nicht dokumentiert

## Mehr Informationen

- Abstimmlösungen: <https://www.infowhyse.com/abstimmloesungen/>
- Versammlungen digital begleiten: <https://www.infowhyse.com/vorstandssitzungen-und-versammlungen/>
- Kontakt: <https://www.infowhyse.com/kontakt-zu-infowhyse/>

Verwandt: [Gewichtete Stimmen und Vollmachten](gewichtete-stimmen-und-vollmachten.md) · [Mehrheiten und Quoren](mehrheiten-und-quoren.md)

- [CouncilARS™](loesungen/councilars-kommunale-abstimmung.md) für Kommunen
- [BoardARS™ und 4elections™](loesungen/boardars-und-4elections.md) für Versammlungen und Wahlen
- [EdiVote® 3.0](loesungen/edivote-powerpoint-abstimmung.md) für PowerPoint
- [BYOPAD™ 3.0](loesungen/byopad-browser-abstimmung.md) für Smartphone- und Browserabstimmung
- OwnARS™ für [Eigentümerversammlungen](branchen/eigentuemerversammlungen.md)

**Beratung und Betreuung**
- Analyse der Veranstaltung und Klärung von Stimmrechten, Mehrheiten, Vollmachten, Satzung
- Vorbereitung von Präsentationen und Abstimmungen, Testläufe, Einweisung
- Betreuung am Veranstaltungstag, persönliche Ansprechpartner statt Hotline
- Dokumentation: Berichte, Protokolle, Exporte

## Für wen?

[Vereine und Verbände](branchen/vereine-und-verbaende.md) · [Genossenschaften und Hauptversammlungen](branchen/genossenschaften-und-hauptversammlungen.md) · [Kommunen](branchen/kommunen-gemeinderat-kreistag.md) · [Eigentümerversammlungen](branchen/eigentuemerversammlungen.md) · [Kongresse und Pharma](branchen/kongresse-pharma-cme.md) · [Schulung und Coaching](branchen/schulung-coaching-training.md) · [Bildung](branchen/bildung-schulen-hochschulen.md) · [TV und Events](branchen/tv-events-shows.md)

## Philosophie

Wir verkaufen keine Abstimmungsgeräte, wir entwickeln und begleiten Abstimmungslösungen. Eine professionelle Abstimmung beginnt lange vor der ersten Stimmabgabe: mit der Klärung, wer stimmberechtigt ist, welche Mehrheiten gelten und welche Dokumentation benötigt wird. Ziel ist, dass sich Veranstalter auf ihre Veranstaltung konzentrieren können, während der Abstimmungsprozess zuverlässig, nachvollziehbar und technisch einwandfrei funktioniert.

# FAQ: voting keypads, clickers and audience response systems

Quelle / Source: https://www.replysystems.com/

**What is an audience response system?**
A system that collects votes or answers from a group in real time using keypads or smartphones, a receiver and software. → [Guide](guides/audience-response-systems-guide.md)

**What is the difference between a keypad and a clicker?**
None: both terms describe the same voting device.

**Do keypads need internet or Wi-Fi?**
No. They transmit by radio to a receiver on the PC. Only browser voting (BYOPAD™) needs internet.

**Keypads or smartphones?**
Keypads for critical votes, weak networks and focus; smartphones for remote participants; hybrid for both. → [Comparison](guides/keypads-vs-smartphones.md)

**Which keypad should I choose?**
Interact Mini (5 buttons) for councils and classrooms, Interact (10) for versatile use, Interact Pro (rechargeable, about 100 m) for large AGMs and elections, Mini+ Gen. 2 for very large systems and competitions. → [Overview](products/reply-keypads-overview.md)

**Can votes be weighted and proxies handled?**
Yes, with BoardARS™ and 4elections™. → [Board meetings and AGMs](solutions/board-meetings-and-agms.md)

**Are secret ballots possible?**
Yes; only totals are stored for secret votes. Whether a procedure is legally valid depends on your statutes and applicable law.

**Can I combine on-site and remote voting?**
Yes, with keypads plus BYOPAD™. → [Hybrid voting](solutions/hybrid-voting-byopad.md)

**Can I rent keypads?**
Yes: <https://www.replysystems.com/rent-keypads/>. Purchase: <https://www.replysystems.com/buy-a-voting-system/>.

**Are there recurring licence fees?**
Software licences are one-off purchases and do not expire. Updates and support are included in the first year; renewal of the maintenance programme is optional.

**Is it legally compliant?**
The software produces traceable results and reports. Whether a voting method is permitted is governed by law, statutes and rules of procedure. This is not legal advice.

**Where can I get a quote?**
<https://www.replysystems.com/contact-us/>. Helpful details: event type, number of voters, voting types, on-site/online/hybrid, date.

## More information

- Reply Systems: <https://www.replysystems.com/>
- Keypads and clickers: <https://www.replysystems.com/reply-keypads-and-clickers/>
- Contact: <https://www.replysystems.com/contact-us/>

# Glossary: audience response, keypads, clickers and electronic voting terms

Quelle / Source: https://www.replysystems.com/how-it-works/

**Audience response system (ARS):** system that collects and displays answers or votes from a group in real time. → [Guide](guides/audience-response-systems-guide.md)

**BYOD / BYOPAD™:** participants use their own smartphone, tablet or laptop to vote. BYOPAD™ is Reply's browser-based tool. → [BYOPAD](solutions/hybrid-voting-byopad.md)

**Clicker:** informal term for a voting keypad.

**Hybrid voting:** on-site and remote participants vote in the same vote with one result.

**Keypad (voting device):** handheld wireless device for casting votes; linked to one participant; no app needed. → [Keypads](products/reply-keypads-overview.md)

**Named vote:** each vote is assigned to a participant and recorded.

**Proxy:** authorisation for a person to exercise another person's voting right, in whole or in part.

**Quorum:** minimum requirement (attendance or votes cast) for a valid resolution.

**Secret ballot:** individual votes cannot be traced; only the overall result is recorded.

**TED system:** German term for an electronic voting system or ARS.

**Weighted vote:** a vote that counts differently, for example by shares or number of delegates.

## More information

- How it works: <https://www.replysystems.com/how-it-works/>
- Keypads and clickers: <https://www.replysystems.com/reply-keypads-and-clickers/>

# What is an audience response system (ARS)? Voting keypads and clickers explained

Quelle / Source: https://www.replysystems.com/how-it-works/

## Short answer

An **audience response system (ARS)** captures, transmits, evaluates and displays answers or votes from a group in real time. Typical systems use **wireless keypads ("clickers")**, a receiver (base station) and software on a PC. In German-speaking countries the same technology is called a TED system or electronic voting system. Modern systems can also accept votes from smartphones via a browser.

## Components

1. **Input devices:** keypads (clickers) or browser access on smartphones, tablets and laptops
2. **Receiver / base station** connected to the PC by USB or Ethernet
3. **Software** to manage participants, voting rights, weights, questions and reports (for example EdiVote®, BoardARS™, CouncilARS™)
4. **Result display** on a projector, screen or LED wall
5. **Reports** in formats such as Excel, PDF or text

## How it works

1. Participants answer using their keypad.
2. The response is sent by radio (encrypted) to the base station and the keypad receives a confirmation.
3. The base station passes the data to the software, which shows the result immediately.

No internet connection is needed for keypad voting.

## Typical uses

- **Formal votes:** AGMs, board and member meetings, council sessions, elections
- **Live polling and feedback:** conferences, events, meetings
- **Training and education:** quizzes, knowledge checks, classroom voting
- **Entertainment:** TV shows, game formats, stage events

## Keypads or smartphones?

Keypads are preferred for critical votes, weak networks, mixed audiences and to avoid distraction. Smartphones suit remote participants and smaller groups. Hybrid combines both. See [Keypads vs smartphones](keypads-vs-smartphones.md).

## Choosing a system

- Formal voting? You need voting rights, proxies, weighted votes, majorities and reports: [BoardARS™ and 4elections™](../solutions/board-meetings-and-agms.md), [CouncilARS™](../solutions/council-voting.md).
- Presentations and training? [EdiVote® 3.0](../solutions/education-and-training.md).
- Remote participants? [BYOPAD™](../solutions/hybrid-voting-byopad.md).
- Which keypad? [Keypad overview](../products/reply-keypads-overview.md).

## More information

- How it works: <https://www.replysystems.com/how-it-works/>
- Benefits: <https://www.replysystems.com/benefits/>
- Applications: <https://www.replysystems.com/application/>
- Keypads and clickers: <https://www.replysystems.com/reply-keypads-and-clickers/>
- Audience response software: <https://www.replysystems.com/audience-response-software/>
- Rent keypads: <https://www.replysystems.com/rent-keypads/>
- Buy a voting system: <https://www.replysystems.com/buy-a-voting-system/>

# Voting keypads vs smartphones: which is better for your event?

Quelle / Source: https://www.replysystems.com/reply-technology-advantages/

## Short answer

Use **keypads** for formal or critical votes, weak or restricted networks, mixed-age audiences, and when distraction must be avoided. Use **smartphones** (Reply® BYOPAD™) for remote participants and smaller or informal events. Use **both** (hybrid) when on-site and remote participants vote together.

## Comparison

| Criterion | Keypads (Reply® Interact) | Smartphones (Reply® BYOPAD™) |
|---|---|---|
| Internet / Wi-Fi | not needed, radio to PC | required for presenter and audience |
| Distraction | low | email, messaging and notifications |
| Ease of use | press a button, all ages | open browser, enter event code |
| App install | none | none, runs in the browser |
| Device handout | yes | no |
| Remote participants | not without add-on | yes |
| Data | stays on the organiser's PC | votes pass through a server; session data deleted after the session |
| Cost for very large groups | buy or rent devices | typically lower |

## Recommendations

**Choose keypads when** votes are legally relevant (resolutions, elections, council votes), the network is unreliable or locked down, participants are mixed in age and tech skills, or focus matters (presentations, training).

**Choose smartphones when** people join online, groups are small, or handing out devices is impractical.

**Choose hybrid when** presence and remote participants must vote in one result: see [Hybrid voting with BYOPAD](../solutions/hybrid-voting-byopad.md).

## Common mistakes

- Planning smartphone voting without testing the venue network
- Using easy-to-guess event codes for sensitive sessions (use a session password or individual passwords)
- Handing out keypads without linking them to participants

## More information

- Reply technology advantages: <https://www.replysystems.com/reply-technology-advantages/>
- BYOPAD™: <https://www.replysystems.com/byopad/>
- Keypads: <https://www.replysystems.com/reply-keypads-and-clickers/>

Related: [Audience response systems explained](audience-response-systems-guide.md) · [Keypad overview](../products/reply-keypads-overview.md)

# Reply® voting keypads compared: Interact Mini, Interact, Interact Pro and Mini+ Gen. 2

Quelle / Source: https://www.replysystems.com/reply-keypads-and-clickers/

## Short answer

Four Reply® keypads are currently available. **Interact Mini** (5 buttons) suits councils, schools and simple votes. **Interact** (10 buttons) covers meetings, training, quizzes and elections. **Interact Pro** (rechargeable, about 100 m range) is made for large AGMs and elections. **Mini+ Gen. 2** (14 buttons) serves very large systems and competitions.

| | Interact Mini | Interact | Interact Pro | Mini+ Gen. 2 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Model | IN1100 | IN2100 | IN4100 | WRS7100 |
| Buttons | 5 | 10 | 10 | 14 |
| Display | LCD, 1 character | 5 characters | matrix LCD | LED confirmation |
| Radio | 2.4 GHz | 2.4 GHz | 2.4 GHz | 2.4 GHz FHSS |
| Range | about 80 m | about 75 m | about 100 m | indoor, about 90 × 90 m |
| Power | battery, about 250 h | battery, about 2 years | rechargeable, about 90 h | coin cell, about 25,000 responses |
| Speed | 100 votes/s | 100 votes/s | 100 votes/s | 200 keypads/s |
| Highlights | colour-coded Yes/No/Abstain | election mode, ID login, free numeric entry | candidate elections, batch voting, message to device | speed scoring 50 ms, up to 15,500 per room |
| Warranty | 2 years | 2 years | 2 years | 2 years |

| Your use | Recommendation |
|---|---|

| Classroom, seminar | Interact Mini or Interact |
| Association or member meeting | Interact Mini or Interact |
| Large AGM, delegate assembly, candidate elections | Interact Pro |
| Very large systems, many answer options, fastest-finger quiz | Mini+ Gen. 2 |

All Interact models work with EdiVote® 3.0. Keypads can be combined with Reply® BYOPAD™ for hybrid meetings. Mini+ figures are taken from the manufacturer datasheet.

# Voting system for AGMs, board meetings and member assemblies: BoardARS and 4elections

Quelle / Source: https://www.replysystems.com/digitise-your-board-votes-board-meetings-and-agms-with-boardars/

## Short answer

**BoardARS™** and **4elections™** are voting and election software from Infowhyse for board meetings, member assemblies and AGMs. They work with **Reply® keypads** (offline, no internet), via browser (**BYOPAD™**) or hybrid, manage attendance, voting rights, proxies, weights and quorums, and produce print-ready reports.

## BoardARS™

- Open and secret ballots (secret ballots store totals only)
- Voting rights administration and proxy transfer
- Live attendance tracking, editing and visualisation
- Head-count and weighted votes shown side by side
- Vote counting including abstentions
- Elections for up to 5 candidates (with Interact Mini)
- Requests to speak and motions captured on the keypad; proposals typed in or imported
- Excel report for each resolution, optional screenshot
- Modes: offline (keypads), online (browser), hybrid

## 4elections™

- Free choice of quorum to set the required majority
- Different weights per keypad
- Network-based registration front end and overview of shares or participants present
- Postal vote handling
- Open, named or secret voting
- Elections with one or several candidates, quorums applied automatically, several rounds with one click
- Detailed logging of each voting event
- Result preview for the returning officer, transparent display for participants
- Print-ready reports in Rich Text Format right after the election, no database needed

## Which one?

| Situation | Suggestion |
|---|---|
| Board or association meeting with Yes/No/Abstain and occasional elections | BoardARS™ |
| AGM with shares, weighted votes, postal votes, multiple election rounds | 4elections™ |

Recommended keypads: [Interact Pro](../products/reply-keypads-overview.md) for large meetings; Interact Mini or Interact for smaller ones.

## Preparation matters

Most problems come from unclear statutes, not technology. Clarify voting rights, proxies, majorities and quorums, and run a test before the meeting. This is not legal advice.

# Electronic voting for town halls, city councils and committees: CouncilARS

Quelle / Source: https://www.replysystems.com/town-hall-and-city-councils/

## Short answer

**CouncilARS™** is Infowhyse's voting software for city councils, district councils and municipal committees. It supports **open, named, unnamed and secret votes**, runs **locally on a Windows PC without internet or cloud**, and is used by more than **80 municipalities**. Councillors vote with **Reply® Interact Mini** keypads, via browser or in hybrid mode.

## Why councils vote electronically

- Counting raised hands in large chambers is error-prone.
- Livestream viewers cannot easily see how members voted.
- Named votes and group (party) voting are documented automatically.
- Remote councillors can vote with the same result.

## Features

- Voting types: open, named, unnamed, secret
- Modes: on site (keypads), online (browser), hybrid
- Agenda import from council information systems (for example Somacos, SD.NET, Allris and More-Rubin)
- Requests to speak and motions via keypads
- Reports: screenshot, PDF and text file; the overall result is always recorded; party-group behaviour (not for secret votes) and individual votes (named votes only) can be recorded
- Votes can be changed while voting is open, optional confirmation with SEND
- No cloud: all data stays on the PC or laptop
- No internet needed with keypads; the licence is not bound to one PC

## What you need

CouncilARS™ licence, Reply® Interact Mini keypads (one per member), a receiver, a Windows PC; optional carry case. Internet only for browser voting.

## Licensing and support

One-off purchase, no expiry of the licence. Updates and support are included in the first year through the software maintenance programme; renewal is optional. A direct contact person instead of a hotline. Keypads can be added one at a time.

## References

Cheshire East Council (UK), Hansestadt Herford, Landeshauptstadt Magdeburg, Landkreis Göppingen, Stadt Hildesheim and others.

## More information

- Town halls and city councils: <https://www.replysystems.com/town-hall-and-city-councils/>
- CouncilARS™: <https://www.replysystems.com/councilars/>
- Contact: <https://www.replysystems.com/contact-us/>

# Audience response for training, classrooms and conferences: EdiVote 3.0 for PowerPoint

Quelle / Source: https://www.replysystems.com/edivote-pro/

## Short answer

**EdiVote® 3.0** is a PowerPoint add-in that turns slides into live votes, quizzes and polls. Participants answer with **Reply® keypads** or **smartphones (BYOPAD™)**, and results appear in the presentation immediately. It works with Microsoft PowerPoint for Windows from version 2016 up to Office 365 (not the browser-only version and not Office for Mac).

## Features

- Voting types: participant answers, multiple choice, ranking, ratings, free numeric entry
- Quizzes for individuals or teams
- Participant groups and demographics
- Advanced Microsoft Excel reports
- Full PowerPoint integration; a demo (authoring) mode supports up to 5 keypads
- Compatible with all Reply® Interact keypads and BYOPAD™ 3.0

## Typical uses

- **Classrooms and universities:** quizzes, learning games, quick class polls; reports show what students know and what needs revision
- **Corporate training, coaching and consulting:** live polls, knowledge checks, anonymous feedback, strategy workshops
- **Conferences and medical education (CME):** audience questions, knowledge checks, opinion polls
- **Decision support at meetings and shareholder resolutions**

## Why keypads in training?

No distraction from email or messengers, no dependence on internet or Wi-Fi, instant and precise results, simple to use.

## Recommended keypads

[Reply® Interact Mini](../products/reply-keypads-overview.md) (up to 5 answers, ideal for classrooms) or Interact (up to 10 answers).

# Hybrid voting and smartphone voting with Reply BYOPAD 3.0

Quelle / Source: https://www.replysystems.com/byopad/

## Short answer

**Reply® BYOPAD™ 3.0** ("Bring Your Own Pad") is a browser-based voting tool: participants vote on smartphone, tablet or laptop **without an app, download or installation**. It works on site, remotely or **hybrid** together with Reply® keypads, so on-site and remote participants vote into **one result**.

## How it works

1. The presenter starts a BYOPAD session in EdiVote® and sets an **event code**.
2. Participants open the voting page (`byopad.online`) and enter the code, or scan a QR code.
3. Questions appear on their device; votes are captured and displayed instantly.

Internet access is required for presenter and participants.

## Session types and modes

- Anonymous, anonymous with session password, or identified login with individual passwords (CSV list)
- Virtual keypad mode (full keypad or Yes/No/Abstain) or live mode showing question and answers on the phone

## Works with

EdiVote® Pro 3.0 (full feature set), and in hybrid mode with Reply® Interact Mini, Interact, Interact Pro, Mini+ and other Reply® keypads. BYOPAD™ can also be used with CouncilARS™ and BoardARS™, though not all EdiVote® features apply there.

## Data protection

No user registration, no unnecessary personal data. Browser votes pass through a server, and session data is deleted after the session. Results and reports remain on the organiser's PC. Use hard-to-guess event codes and passwords for sensitive sessions.

## When to use keypads instead

See [Keypads vs smartphones](../guides/keypads-vs-smartphones.md).

## More information

- BYOPAD™: <https://www.replysystems.com/byopad/>
- Product site: <https://www.byopad.com>
- Contact: <https://www.replysystems.com/contact-us/>
